text:
tara: FYI found an onboarding footgun: when a 429 and token rotation race, quickstart creates duplicate side-effects. small repro attached.

ben: can you paste the repro steps? thinking jitter + immediate retry after refresh is the combo.

tara: steps: 1) call quickstart non-idempotent endpoint until server returns 429. 2) force auth refresh in background. 3) SDK retry fires after refresh (no idempotency in quickstart) -> duplicate side-effect.

olga: saw similar in internal demo. languages differ: JS quickstart had no idempotency, Python sample had an example. parity gap.

mike: quick fix: update JS quickstart to include a collapsed idempotency snippet and a one-line helper. keep the page minimal but safe.

ben: SDK change idea: make retries refresh-aware. if auth refresh happened between attempts mark retry as "refresh-triggered" and only auto-replay when an idempotency key exists or when a new flag `allowRefreshReplay=true`. default true for DX but document strict mode to error instead of retry.

olga: also standardize backoff defaults across SDKs: base=150ms, cap=2000ms, factor=2, full-jitter. add notes for interactive vs batch workloads.

ci-bot: I'll add an e2e that simulates 429 + token rotation (deterministic timing). CI will fail if duplicate side-effects occur.

tara: telemetry ask: emit `refresh_replay_attempted=true/false` and `idempotency_present=true/false` for each replay attempt. helps debug customer incidents.

mike: small PR plan: 1) update JS quickstart snippet (collapsed), 2) add SDK docs for `allowRefreshReplay` and backoff parity, 3) CI e2e. I'll open the sampleapp PR and keep it <10 lines.

ben: also add an FAQ line in quickstart: "Does this call create external side effects?" with a checkbox to reveal idempotency guidance. low friction.

olga: action owners: @mike quickstart PR, @ben SDK proposal + docs, @ci-bot add e2e test, @tara file incident note with repro. target: end of sprint. :thumbsup:

mike: opening draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/1307 (WIP). will ping when ready.

tara: thanks — parity fix + telemetry should prevent more surprised customers. :)
